messages.subject: IsoriX for marine isoscapes
messages.body_plain:
Hi and greetings from Alaska,
I'm trying to produce isoscapes of eastern Bering Sea zooplankton and I keep getting stuck with using the IsoriX guide, likely because the example is used with terrestrial maps and H isotopes, where I'm in the marine/offshore realm. Is there anyone here that has used IsoriX with marine systems?  I'm on my phone now but I can share my messy code (haha) in a follow-up email. Any help would be GREATLY appreciated.
Thanks!
Todd
